basic_details.job_title: UoH Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Senior Research Fellow/Junior Research Fellow (Physics) Posts
basic_details.short_information: The School of Physics, University of Hyderabad, has one post of Senior Research Fellow (SRF)/Junior Research Fellow (JRF) in a CSIR-sponsored research project on rare-earth-free permanent magnets. The post is initially for 12 months. The fellowship is Rs.42,000/- p.m. for SRF and Rs.37,000/- p.m. for JRF, plus HRA at the applicable rate. SRF candidates need an M.Sc./BE/B.Tech with two years of research experience or an M.Tech/ME, and JRF candidates need a qualifying degree with 55% marks and a valid NET/GATE score. Applications go by email to [email protected], and the last date for receipt is

age_limit.details: Post Age Limit Senior Research Fellow (SRF) 32 years Junior Research Fellow (JRF) 28 years | The application form asks for the date of birth and age as on the last date of the notification.

qualification.details: Specialization in Condensed Matter Physics. Experience in synthesizing and characterizing structural and magnetic properties of intermetallic alloys. | The notice states that an SRF candidate will be preferred if found suitable.

how_to_apply: Fill in Form-B, "Application for Position in the Project", attached to the advertisement, with a recent photograph pasted on it.

In the form, give the post applied for, the notification number and date, personal details, correspondence address, present position, educational qualifications, experience and the names and addresses of two referees, and sign the declaration.
Put self-attested copies of all certificates supporting the information in the application into a single PDF.
Send the application to [email protected] so that it is received by 4 December 2026.
Filled-in Form-B with a recent photograph.
Self-attested copies of all certificates, enclosed in a single PDF.

Form-B also has a column "Proof enclosed" against each entry and a section for application fee payment details (bank name, DD/receipt number, amount), but the advertisement itself does not mention any fee.

content_sections.heading: UoH Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee or the selection process.

rows.details: Economically-viable Rare-Earth-Free Permanent Magnets based on Binary and Pseudo-binary Intermetallic Alloys of Fe
Initially 12 months, extendable till completion of the project
SRF Rs.42,000/- p.m. + HRA; JRF Rs.37,000/- p.m. + HRA
School of Physics, University of Hyderabad, Hyderabad

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The single position is advertised at two levels. The essential qualification for each level is: Specialization in Condensed Matter Physics. Experience in synthesizing and characterizing structural and magnetic properties of intermetallic alloys. The notice states that an SRF candidate will be preferred if found suitable. The application form asks for the date of birth and age as on the last date of the notification. The age relaxation row of the notice refers to the CSIR HRDG page https://csirhrdg.res.in/Home/Index/1/Default/3283/63. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: M.Sc./BE/B.Tech or equivalent degree, and at least two years of post-MSc/BE/BTech research experience as evidenced from published papers in standard refereed journals, OR M.Tech/ME or equivalent degree in Engineering/Technology
BS 4 years programme/Integrated BS-MS/MSc/BE/BTech or equivalent degree, with 55% marks and passing of valid NET/GATE score

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The project tenure is initially for 12 months and may be extended up till the completion of the project, based upon the performance of the candidate and fund availability. The appointment is purely temporary and on a contractual basis, and the person appointed has no right to claim any regular appointment in the University.

content_sections.heading: UoH Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: To carry out the experimental research work in the field of intermetallic alloys (synthesis, structural and magnetic characterisation).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UoH Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Filled-in Form-B with a recent photograph. Self-attested copies of all certificates, enclosed in a single PDF.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in UoH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 vacancy, for the post of Senior Research Fellow (SRF)/Junior Research Fellow (JRF) in the School of Physics.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of filled-in applications is 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the JRF level?
faq.answer: A BS 4 years programme/Integrated BS-MS/MSc/BE/BTech or equivalent degree, with 55% marks and a valid NET/GATE score.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 32 years for SRF and 28 years for JRF, relaxable up to 5 years for SC/ST/OBC, women and physically handicapped candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the fellowship amount?
faq.answer: SRF gets Rs.42,000/- p.m. and JRF gets Rs.37,000/- p.m., each plus HRA at the applicable rate.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the fellowship?
faq.answer: Yes, HRA is paid in addition to the fellowship, as per the applicable rate, for both SRF and JRF.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Send the filled-in Form-B, with self-attested copies of all certificates in a single PDF, to [email protected] by 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is purely temporary and contractual, initially for 12 months and extendable till the end of the project, with no right to claim a regular appointment in the University.

faq.question: Q9. I applied against the advertisement dated 10/11/2026. Do I need to apply again?
faq.answer: No, earlier applicants do not need to reapply, though they may update their credentials or missing documents, if any.

faq.question: Q10. Will SRF or JRF candidates be preferred?
faq.answer: The notice states that an SRF candidate will be preferred if found suitable.
